title: Layout system: 4pt spacing scale, per-breakpoint container widths, safe-area handling
description: All layout derives from a single grid and spacing system on a 4pt base scale. Container maximum widths are declared per breakpoint. Spacing values outside the scale do not appear in component styles. Notched and rounded viewports are handled via safe-area insets so no content or control sits under hardware cutouts.
rationale: Ad-hoc spacing is the visible signature of unspecified layout. A closed scale makes drift detectable and keeps composed screens coherent.
